scientific_integrity: The proof uses the source's exact equivalent rational characterization and exhausts the only three multiplicative shapes with Omega(n)<=2. The packaged finite computation is a regression check, not the proof of the infinite statement.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies only to positive mu, witnesses n>mu, and Omega(n)<=2. It does not settle the existence of larger mu-Sondow numbers with three or more prime factors.
title: Complete \(\Omega\le2\) classification of large positive \(\mu\)-Sondow witnesses
